JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) , 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH disb AS (
  SELECT d.LN_PRD_K,
         SUM(d.PRNCP_AMT) AS total_disbursed
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K
),
repay AS (
  SELECT r.LN_PRD_K,
         SUM(r.PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS total_paid
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON r.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY r.LN_PRD_K
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       COALESCE(d.total_disbursed,0) - COALESCE(r.total_paid,0) AS outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN disb d ON p.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
LEFT JOIN repay r ON p.LN_PRD_K = r.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

SELECT

WITH atm_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
  wire_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wire_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

-- Drop the fact_complaint table
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT
    ACCT_K,
    CLSNG_BAL_AMT,
    BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-06-30','2025-12-31')
  )
),
  bal_30 AS (
    SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_30
    FROM bal
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-06-30')
  ),
  bal_31 AS (
    SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_31
    FROM bal
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-12-31')
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM bal_31 b31
JOIN bal_30 b30 ON b31.ACCT_K = b30.ACCT_K
WHERE b31.bal_31 < b30.bal_30 * 0.90;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS curr_seg
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), prev AS (
  SELECT d.CUST_K,
         d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS prev_seg
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
  JOIN (
    SELECT CUST_K, MAX(VRSN_NBR) AS max_prev
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = FALSE
    GROUP BY CUST_K
  ) p ON d.CUST_K = p.CUST_K AND d.VRSN_NBR = p.max_prev
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers_with_segment_change
FROM curr c
JOIN prev p ON c.CUST_K = p.CUST_K
WHERE c.curr_seg IS DISTINCT FROM p.prev_seg;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub;

WITH disputes_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
  transfers_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes_2025 d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM transfers_2025 t WHERE t.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
);

WITH d24 AS (
  SELECT f.LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
), d25 AS (
  SELECT f.LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d24
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d25);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1,
    f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH month_ends AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT, MTH_NBR, CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE IS_MTH_END = TRUE AND CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
  latest_bal AS (
    SELECT f.BUS_DT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN month_ends m ON f.BUS_DT_K = m.DT_K
  )
SELECT m.MTH_NBR AS month,
       SUM(lb.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM month_ends m
LEFT JOIN latest_bal lb ON lb.BUS_DT_K = m.DT_K
GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR;

WITH cust_2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND IS_CURR = TRUE
), intrc_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM cust_2025 c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intrc_2025 i WHERE i.CUST_K = c.CUST_K);

SELECT
    d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
WHERE d.EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (d.EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR d.EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

SELECT
  c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
  c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c

QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY SUM(f.STLM_AMT) DESC) <= 3
